input.quote: for all fees, expenses, losses, claims, actions, suits, damages and liabilities (including reasonable legal fees and expenses) resulting from the Servicer's (including in its capacity as Custodian) willful misconduct, bad faith or gross negligence in performing its obligations under the Transaction Documents
input.rationale: Section 6.3(a) contains counterparty-side indemnities (Servicer at p0291, Marketing Agent at p0292) with a standard notice and defence-control procedure at p0293, but the trigger is limited to Cellco's willful misconduct, bad faith or gross negligence. There is no third-party intellectual property infringement indemnity anywhere in the document, which fails both the preferred and the fallback position. We target the fallback: a concise IP infringement indemnity inserted as Section 6.3(a)(iii), with the customary Issuer-modification, combination and specification exclusions, procure/modify/replace/refund remedies and a 3x annual fees super-cap, leaving the existing Proceedings procedure, survival and repayment mechanics untouched. We did not pursue the preferred position because the clause's existing indemnitee set (the Owner Trustee, Indenture Trustee and their officers, directors, employees and agents) runs beyond Customer and affiliates and cannot be brought within the preferred scope by an addition; the preferred procedure also lacks an indemnitee cooperation duty, which we would raise in negotiation rather than redline.

ops.text: (iii) Each of the Servicer and the Marketing Agent, severally and not jointly, will indemnify the Issuer against any third-party claim that the systems, software, reports or other deliverables it provides in performing its obligations under the Transaction Documents infringe any intellectual property right, except to the extent the claim arises from modifications made by the Issuer, the Issuer's combination of those items with items not supplied by the Servicer or the Marketing Agent, or the Issuer's specifications. In that event the Servicer or the Marketing Agent, as applicable, will procure the right to continue using the affected item, or modify or replace it so that it is non-infringing, and if none of the foregoing is available on commercially reasonable terms, refund the fees paid for the affected item. The aggregate liability of the Servicer and the Marketing Agent under this clause (iii) will not exceed 3x the annual fees payable to it under the Transaction Documents.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added a Servicer/Marketing Agent intellectual property infringement indemnity in Section 6.3(a), since the existing trigger is limited to willful misconduct, bad faith or gross negligence and leaves the Issuer exposed to infringement claims arising from Cellco's systems and reports. This is our fallback position, with the customary modification, combination and specification exclusions, procure/modify/replace/refund remedies and a 3x annual fees cap.
proposal.summary: Add a Servicer/Marketing Agent IP infringement indemnity with standard exclusions, procure/modify/replace/refund remedies and a 3x annual fees super-cap
